title: Charger prototype finding its way to Model S
summary: A one-minute Tesla clip showing a prototype robotic snake charger that finds a Model S's charge port and plugs itself in.
why: Brought up whenever robotic or automatic EV charging comes up, as the memorable 2015 demo that never became a product.

quote.text: Tesla demoed that in 2015, but didn't make it into a product.[1]
